# Copilot Instructions

A pointer. The source of truth for every AI tool here is `AGENTS.md` at the
repository root.

Before proposing changes, read `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/routing.md`.

Branch names: `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `refactor/*`. Never propose a
direct commit to the default branch.

Keep output concise, technical and reviewable. Do not duplicate repository-wide
rules here; add them to `AGENTS.md`.
